items.title: fix(ui): preserve cloud startup input and restore recovery (#138469)
items.summary: fix(ui): preserve cloud startup input and restore recovery (#138469) * fix(ui): recover restored cloud startup after chunk failure * fix(ui): retain cloud recovery across passive session updates Keep a failed lazy runtime load and its restored owner timestamp stable across session and profile notifications. Refresh recovery keys after Reset and again before a delayed reload so retired recovery cannot authorize it. Validated with 81 focused tests, the production browser regression, full changed-file checks, a clean independent review, and an actual Gateway/paired-node session-switch and Retry flow with one initial send. * test: tolerate descriptor reuse after failed spawn Reuse the existing descriptor identity check so unrelated fd-number reuse cannot produce a false leak failure. The assertion still rejects a live original pipe. * fix(ui): preserve unsaved cloud starts during recovery Track confirmed recovery persistence separately from persistence intent. Offer an explicit discard-and-reload action for unsaved starts, bound to the current startup attempt, connection owner, and pending records. Share reload custody across stale assets, responsive service-worker updates, verified updates, terminal-policy refreshes, and login recovery. Keep saved starts on the canonical document recovery path after cached module failures. Add regression coverage for failed saves, retained actions, reload owners, and the production service-worker listener; keep mobile warnings and actions fully visible. Release-note context: cloud startup errors and Retry remain visible across session changes; recovery preserves pending input until an explicit choice.

items.title: fix(testbox): preserve hydrated runtime across native sync (#138612)
items.summary: fix(testbox): preserve hydrated runtime across native sync (#138612) * fix(testbox): reject rsync that deletes ignored runtime Require GNU rsync before delegated Testbox sync so Apple openrsync cannot erase hydrated dependencies and ignored runtime data. Preserve caller-owned PATH, source verification, and administrative commands; document the explicit prerequisite and fresh-lease recovery. Follow-up to #138404 and #138153. * fix(testbox): resolve rsync before its compatibility probe * fix(testbox): isolate sync from the hydrated execution workspace Keep native Git cleanup and rsync in a disposable transport checkout, then apply the verified source bundle and run payloads in the original prepared workspace. Preserve runtime paths and raw source/privacy/deletion checks; invalidate leases when workspace preparation or the selected workflow changes. Discard the GNU-only prerequisite after live proof showed native cleanup removes newly ignored runtime before rsync. Require the advertised prepared-artifact-workspace capability for artifact requests so older Crabbox clients cannot collect stale transport files. Runtime-preservation follow-up to #138404 and #138153. No release or merge.

items.summary: 9月2日思科針對網路設備平臺IOS XR發布9月份安全強化更新，總共修補7個漏洞，2個為重大等級，其餘為高風險等級，該公司強調，這些弱點影響所有版本的IOS XR，其中包含了IOS XR7（LNT），由於沒有替代緩解措施，呼籲用戶應套用軟體更新因應。
